correctness.rationale: TARGET disproof fails at load-bearing Lemma 3. Lemma 1 (lambda0 in (5,6)) and Lemma 2 (||A_inf||=2) check out and the script ran clean, but Lemma 3(i) 'M hyperfinite => amenable subfactor' is false. Amenable extremal => index=||Gamma||^2 is conditional on amenability; hyperfiniteness of the ambient does not imply amenability. Positive counterexamples: Bisch 1994 irreducible R-subfactor at index 9/2 with A_infinity graphs that is Popa-non-amenable, and Bisch-Caceres 2025 full text constructing hyperfinite TLJ (hence A_inf) subfactors at index 5 and other indices !=4. Hence hyperfinite A_inf does not force index 4, and the contradiction collapses. Headline truth is undecided by this proof.

originality.rationale: The exact headline 'no irreducible hyperfinite A_inf subfactor at index ~5.04892 (largest root of x^3-6x^2+5x-1)' is not recorded or implied by the nearest prior. The (5,5.25] classification explicitly retains TLJ A_inf at every index >4 and lists only su(2)5 and su(3)4 besides A_inf/A(1)_inf at ~5.04892, without deciding hyperfinite realizability. Bisch-Caceres 2025 constructs hyperfinite A_inf only for [4,5] and 3+sqrt5 and conjectures existence at every finite-depth index, i.e. the opposite direction. No prior states or implies the claimed non-existence.
